Not run: the full `camcraft-app` lib suite (only the `wire` filter ran), the ui heavy and ignored lanes, and clippy on the remaining app/ui test binaries. The diff does not touch their code.

**Law checks.**

- Prime Directive: the widening loop is bounded (`PASSES`, grow-only scales) and refuses by name with a point (`too_far`, `tangled`, `crossing`, `lead_in`). `crates/motion/src/wire_edm/ruled_widen.rs`. No `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` in the new non-test code (checked in the diff files; the only hits are in `#[cfg(test)]`).
- Index math is safe: in `clearance` the `seg - 1` branch runs only when `seg` is neither 0 nor last (`crates/motion/src/wire_edm/ruled_laws.rs:196`). `out.per.get_mut` guards both ends.
- Numbers: `away()` returns early on zero or non-finite spans. The door bounds the tolerance to 0..=0.25 mm and rejects non-finite values (`crates/app/src/operation/types/wire_edm.rs`). Verify refuses `Unreadable` when the tolerance is not below the kerf offset (`crates/sim/src/verify/wire/finding.rs`).
- Everything Is a Command: both parameters change through `EditOperationParams`; undo restores, and the pinning test proves it (`crates/app/tests/wire_verify_tol.rs`).
- Project file: both new keys have serde defaults; an old file loads unchanged, and the round-trip test checks both keys. No format bump - correct, none is needed.
- Stamp: the stand-off rule enters the digest; the verify tolerance does not, and the comment says why. A widening change invalidates the stamp; the undo test proves the `Ok` again.
- MCP: the keys ride the existing edit path through `project::params_from_json` (`crates/app/src/mcp/edit.rs:74`). `mcp_wire_contour` is green. No new command, so no new tool.
- Placement and layers: each test sits in the crate it names. The sim module split keeps the files near 400 lines. Provenance lines are present.
- Body: has the `Changelog:` line, ends `Fixes #1170`, and no process file is touched.
- Clean-room: the rule is stated from public EDM practice; no outside material.

**Notes (not blocking).**

1. The `camcraft-ui` clippy error is a dead `MIN_LABEL_PX` constant. It exists in the main of the trial-merge base and current main removed it (`38fb8543a`). This PR does not touch that file.
2. `crates/app/src/posting_wire.rs` is 411 lines. It is still over the 400 line guide. It shrank by 10 lines in this PR. Not a blocker.
3. The 4-axis golden check now accepts numbers within three counts on the pose words (`same_program`). The strict law gate still compares the whole program byte for byte, so safety still decides there. This is recorded in `docs/decisions/1170-wire-ruling-kerf.md`. An accepted reading.
4. The tolerance is not cross-checked against the kerf offset at command creation. The refusal comes at verify time, with the numbers in the text. The kerf is a machine context, so a creation-time check is not possible in all cases. Noted only.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
